subject: Executive headcount confirmation & offer scheduling runbook
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, emily@talentpartners.com
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Executive HC confirmation — Q3 slate & offer scheduling runbook

Team,

Following our sync last week, finalizing the Q3 exec slate today so we can proceed with offers next week. Summary in the attached workbook (exec_hc_summary.xlsx) — two confirmed headcount requests:

- SVP Product (req# EX-2027-09): comp band target = $325k–$375k base; equity 0.8%–1.2%
- Head of Infrastructure (req# EX-2027-10): comp band target = $285k–$335k base; equity 0.6%–1.0%

Asks:
1) Aditya — please confirm permission to extend within the top of band plus sign-on up to $40k for the SVP role.
2) Marcus — confirm who will be the offer approver/signer for each role (you or Vivek).
3) Mina/People Ops — confirm target start dates we can propose (ideally between Oct 4–18).
4) Emily (Talent Partners) — queue the two candidates for offer-ready materials; use the attached offer_template_redwood.docx and prepare DocuSign packets.

Timeline (proposed):
- Today (Aug 14): leadership approvals + finalize comp/target
- Aug 16: legal review on template + redlines
- Aug 18–20: offer calls + DocuSign envelopes out
- Aug 25: target acceptance/probable start date confirmation

Notes: please flag any concerns about budgeting or escalation to the CEO office by COB. I included the recommended default fallback offer for each role in the workbook.

Thanks — would like a one-line approval from each approver by 12:00pm PDT today so recruiting can proceed.

– Lauren Bishop
VP, Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Executive HC confirmation — Q3 slate & offer scheduling runbook

+1 to proceed.

Approve top-of-band for SVP Product and sign-on up to $40k for a strategic hire — I want the package to be competitive. For Head of Infra, approve mid-to-top band but hold sign-on to $20k unless countered.

Small ask: please include a clause for 6-month performance milestone tied to 15% of equity vesting schedule (we can have Legal draft the language).

Aditya Rao
Chief Product Officer
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: 2027-08-14T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive HC confirmation — Q3 slate & offer scheduling runbook

Thanks — we can sign both offers; Vivek prefers to sign SVP Product and I will sign Head of Infrastructure. A few clarifications:

- Compensation bands: bump SVP base cap to $380k (from $375k) only if candidate brings a proven enterprise revenue track record and public-company scale experience. Otherwise keep as-is.
- Equity: for SVP, agree 0.8%–1.2% but ask for 1.25% provision if candidate moves into CxO remit within 12 months — Legal, please advise on precedent.
- Sign-on: Marcus to approve $40k for SVP in-market exceptions; otherwise capped at $25k.
- Start dates: Mina, confirm whether we can offer a flexible start (Oct 4–Nov 1) to accommodate notice periods.

Forwarding to legal for the milestone vesting clause and to external counsel for any precedent on acceleration. Also tagging Finance (Vivek) for final budget confirmation.

Subject: Re: Executive HC confirmation — Q3 slate & offer scheduling runbook (FINAL sign-offs)

Thank you all — consolidating final decisions here so Talent can execute: 

1) SVP Product (EX-2027-09) — Approved
   - Base: $325k–$380k (top exceptions allowed by Marcus/Aditya approval)
   - Equity: 0.8%–1.25% (1.25% only on CxO-prospect clause; Legal to draft language)
   - Sign-on: up to $40k (Marcus/Aditya approval required for exceptions)
   - Signer: Vivek Kulkarni (CFO)
   - DocuSign packet: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/REDWOOD-EXEC-OFFERS-2027
2) Head of Infrastructure (EX-2027-10) — Approved
   - Base: $285k–$335k
   - Equity: 0.6%–1.0%
   - Sign-on: up to $25k standard; exceptions require Marcus approval
   - Signer: Marcus Lin (CRO)
Operational next steps:
- Emily: prepare offer letters using the attached template and include the 6-month performance milestone clause (Legal to draft).
- Mina: confirm candidate start window flexibility and send proposed onboarding schedule to hiring managers by Aug 17.
- Vivek: finance to confirm final budget allocation and update headcount tracker (link to spreadsheet above).
- Legal (external counsel): please review the milestone/acceleration language and advise on practice by Aug 16.

If there are no further objections by EOD Aug 15, Talent will initiate offer calls on Aug 18. I will triage any last-minute escalations to the CEO office.

Appended: exec_hc_summary.xlsx (breakdowns, fallback offers, comp rationale) and offer_template_redwood.docx.
